PART  III – GAZETTE EXTRA ORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 19.12.2019
REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14
BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land No. 317 of Block 02, con-
tained  in  the  Cadastral  Map  No.  320298,  situated  in  the  Village  of  Hendeniya  within  the  Grama  Niladhari  Division  of  No.  09  -
Haendeniya West in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Udunuwara, in the District of Kandy, in the Province of Central, referred to
in Notice No. 32/0389 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1755/12 of 25th April, 2012 in
terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
